necessary_context.content: Section 3.1 defines the C² Euclidean function class by initial gap and global gradient/Hessian Lipschitz bounds. Oracle returns only exact (f,gradient), not Hessians. Complexity uses a least almost-sure query cap and per-fixed-function success probability at least 2/3, then supremum over finite dimensions.
necessary_context.name: Exact first-order model

necessary_context.content: Definition 7.1 is an analysis oracle: public spectrum/partition, all-block matrix and latent-coordinate products, scheduled RHS disclosure and later full rotation disclosure, plus censored value/gradient. Equality with the true exact first-order transcript is established on a policy-dependent high-probability event; unconditional domination is not claimed.
necessary_context.name: Auxiliary information versus actual oracle
